## 说明

- Generated projects use the pinned public Cargo Git SDK and include TypeScript contracts; first build requires access to the Git repository or a populated Cargo cache.
- A and D builds enable the microsoft feature; B never does. Exactly one mode feature is the Cargo default.
- The mock adapter is a development aid only and is labelled MOCK in the window; it is not acceptance evidence.
- The host IPC represents installation.installedEpochMs as a decimal string or null; SDK Rust and instance.json retain their numeric representation. Omitted installation or timestamp fields retain the SDK defaults.
